settings.heading: Talk to the atelier
settings.text: We answer every message ourselves, within two working days. If your question is about a commission, the bespoke enquiry form will get you a more useful first reply.

settings.question: Where are you?
settings.answer: 18 Clerkenwell Green, London EC1R 0DP, on the first floor. Farringdon is a five-minute walk. Please book before you visit — the bench is not a shop floor.

settings.question: Do you take walk-ins?
settings.answer: No. Appointments are Tuesday to Saturday and take about an hour. There is no charge and no obligation.

settings.question: Can you resize or repair a ring you did not make?
settings.answer: Usually. Send a photograph and we will tell you honestly whether it is worth doing and what it would cost.
